title: AndroidAPS is stopped when processing Medtronic pump history
symptom: AndroidAPS 2.8.2 is stopped every time the pump sends history, 100% reproducible. The app restarts during retrieving historical data from the insulin pump after changing the pump battery. Log shows parsing of history causes an exception: org.joda.time.IllegalFieldValueException: Value 0 for dayOfMonth must be in the range [1,31].
cause: The problem was the BGReceived512 entry in the pump history parsing.
fix: A PR was merged to fix the issue, and a hotfix branch was created based on master containing all 3 Medtronic fixes.
evidence_quote: PR was merged, so this is fixed... Problem was BGReceived512 entry... It should work correctly now...
